candidates.title: Will the maximum temperature be 52-53° on Nov 28, 2026?
candidates.rules_primary: If the maximum temperature recorded at Chicago (CLIMDW) for Nov 28, 2026, is between 52-53° fahrenheit according to The Weather Company, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
Not all weather data is the same. While checking a source like AccuWeather or Google Weather may help guide your decision, the official and final value used to determine this market is the maximum/minimum temperature as reported by the Weather Company.

Reading weather data
Preliminary Weather Company data may be subject to rounding and conversion differences from the final reported value.
Use caution when interpreting preliminary Weather Company readings.

If it is determined in the sole discretion of the Exchange that there is a material error in the initial non-preliminary publication, Expiration may be held until the publication of a non-materially-erroneous data revision or until the Expiration Date, whichever comes first. If no data is available at the end of this period, all markets will resolve to the last fair price determined by Kalshi. Please note, a status of "Final" on weather.com/kalshi is provided for convenience only, and does not guarantee data to be error-free and thus exempt from the above.

candidates.title: Will it rain in New York City between Nov 28 and Nov 29, 2026?
candidates.rules_primary: If the total precipitation at CLINYC in New York City on any day within November 28, 2026 through November 29, 2026 is strictly greater than 0 inches, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
Not all weather data is the same. While checking a source like AccuWeather or Google Weather may help guide your decision, the official and final value used to determine this market as reported by the Weather Company.

Reading weather data
Data for CLINYC can be found at https://weather.com/kalshi.
“Trace” amounts (T) and missing daily precipitation values are counted as 0 inches.

candidates.title: Will the rate of core CPI inflation be above 2.6% for the year ending in November 2026?
candidates.rules_primary: If the Consumer Price Index (CPI) for All Urban Consumers: All Items less Food and Energy increases by more than 2.6% in the twelve months ending November 2026 (as represented by the one-decimal place value reported by the Bureau of Labor Statistics), then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: In the case of a delay in data caused by a federal government shutdown impacting the reliability of the Source Agency, the market’s latest Expiration Date will be extended to the sooner of the release of the Underlying or six months after the end of the government shutdown.

candidates.title: Will there be at least 20 presidential nominations sent to the Senate in the week of Nov 22, 2026?
candidates.rules_primary: If Donald Trump has sent at least 20 nominations to the U.S. Senate from Nov 22, 2026 through Nov 28, 2026 (as checked on the “Presidential Actions” page at whitehouse.gov before 10:00 AM ET on Nov 29, 2026), then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
How this is resolved

The market solely resolves to the publication dates visibly displayed on the "Presidential Actions" tab at whitehouse.gov before 10:00 AM ET on Nov 29, 2026.
The week runs from Nov 22, 2026 through Nov 28, 2026.

Payout criteria

If a person receives multiple qualifying nominations within the period, they will each count separately.
For example, Trump's March 4 nomination of Kevin Warsh (https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/2026/03/nominations-sent-to-the-senate-b376/) is considered two nominations.

candidates.title: Will the Democratic party win the Senate in 2028?
candidates.rules_primary: If the Democratic party has won control of the Senate in 2028, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: This market may be determined early based on a consensus of media calls projecting control of the U.S. Senate. See full rules for details. Otherwise, victory will be determined by the party identification of the President pro tempore of the Senate on February 1, 2029.

candidates.title: Will Trump nominate Michelle Bowman as a member of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System before Jan 1, 2027?
candidates.rules_primary: If Michelle Bowman is nominated as a member of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System after Issuance and before Jan 1, 2027 (ET). then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: Official announcements made by the President (or President-elect) of Michelle Bowman's nomination shall satisfy the Payout Criterion, even if they are not yet sent to the Senate.

candidates.title: Will “This Week” weighted average advertised price for Avocados, Hass, each, for December 4, 2026 be above $0.80?
candidates.rules_primary: If the “This Week” weighted average advertised price for Avocados, Hass, each, as reported in the USDA AMS Weekly Grocery Store Specialty Crops Feature Activity report scheduled for publication on December 4, 2026 is above $0.80, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: This market uses advertised retail prices, not transaction prices. The relevant value is the “This Week” Wtd Avg Price for the row with Commodity “Avocados,” Variety “Hass,” and Unit “each” in the National Conventional Summary section of the USDA AMS Weekly Grocery Store Specialty Crops Feature Activity report. Prices for other avocado varieties, sizes, package counts, organic avocados, regional tables, “Last Week,” or “Last Year” do not count.

candidates.title: Will year-over-year percentage change in U.S. electricity prices for November 2026 be above 3.2%?
candidates.rules_primary:
If the year-over-year percentage change in U.S. electricity prices for November 2026 is above 

3.2%, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
“Year-over-year percentage change in U.S. electricity prices” means the unadjusted 12-month percent change for “Electricity” in the Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI-U), U.S. city average, as published by the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.

Resolution uses the percentage change published in the first BLS CPI release reporting November 2026 data, at its published precision. The value will not be recalculated from index levels. Subsequent revisions will not affect resolution.

candidates.title: Will the 12-month percentage change in CPI-U in December 2028 be above 2.0%?
candidates.rules_primary: If the 12-month percentage change in CPI-U, U.S. city average, all items, not seasonally adjusted, in December 2028 is above 2.0%, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary: The initially reported value for December 2028 will be used. This market concerns the 12-month percentage change for December 2028, not the annual-average percentage change for the specified year.
